log_syslog.description: If true, logs are sent to syslog; otherwise, written to log_file.

log_file.description: Path to the local log file when log_syslog is false.

arplog_file.description: Path to log ARP cache poisoning events (used only when arp_poison=on).

arp_poison.description: Whether ARP cache poisoning is enabled. Accepts 'on' or 'off'.

signatures.description: Whether protocol signatures (e.g., for FTP, HTTP) are detected. Accepts 'on' or 'off'.

sniff_protocols.description: List of protocols to actively sniff for credentials. Common values: ssh, ftp, http, imap, pop, smtp, telnet, vnc.

ignore_hosts.description: List of hosts (by IP or hostname) to skip during sniffing. Each host should be listed on its own line in the rendered config.

interfaces.description: List of network interfaces to sniff on. If empty, dsniff will sniff on all interfaces. Example: ['eth0', 'wlan0'].
